title: PHENIX prompt photons: gg -> gamma g loop-induced component only

pdf_ensembles.combination: independent replica variances added in quadrature

physics.event_simulation: QCD+QED shower, hadronization, remnants, and MPI
physics.pdf_accuracy: NLO PDF inputs do not promote the hard prediction to NLO accuracy
physics.photon_production: Only native MEPP2GammaJetLoop, gg -> gamma g, AmplitudeMode Massive; massless u,d,s and particle-data c,b,t masses
physics.accuracy_scope: Loop-induced hard contribution plus QCD/QED shower; not a complete NLO or NNLO prompt-photon calculation
physics.fiducial: All non-hadron-decay photons, |eta|<0.25; spectra 6<pT<30 GeV; isolated ALL 6<pT<20 GeV
physics.isolation: DeltaR_eta_phi<0.5; sum of other visible particle energies <0.1 E_gamma; charged momentum >=0.2 GeV and neutral energy >=0.3 GeV
physics.acceptance: Particle-level full-cone proxy for acceptance-corrected data; not a detector simulation
physics.generation_cuts: Born photon pT>4 GeV; optional disjoint PhotonKtCut slices, including the open upper tail
physics.mpi_spin: MPI follows the installed underlying-event model; beam-spin dependence of additional scatterings is not separately modeled
physics.counting: Every accepted photon; same-event contributions grouped per bin before filling, preserving event-level diagonal MC sumW2; no inter-bin covariance exported
physics.combination_status: Additional hard-process component for the expanded PHENIX campaign. Add normalized per-helicity yields and independent variances to tree photon+jet and dijets before forming A_LL; do not pool as repeated tree events or rescale by an assumed 15 percent.
